title: Phase information transfer by post-selection in Spin--Mechanical assisted magnetometry
summary: Quantum information transfer between light-matter-type systems is poised to enable important applications, while also serving as a testbed for theoretical investigation. Such systems can be realized with spins coupled to a mechanical oscillator, a platform that has been extensively studied both theoretically and experimentally. Early demonstrations of quantum information transfer have relied mostly on coherent control. However, measurement-induced backaction has emerged as a strong alternative for quantum control.
